findings.title: totalPages off-by-one when count is exact multiple of limit
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6 totalPages is Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50/50, 100/50) this reports one extra empty page, enables the next button to advance to an empty page, and shows e.g. 1/2 instead of 1/1. It should be ceil(user_count/limit).

findings.title: Next pagination can set offset to user_count (empty page)
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6 the next action clamps offset with Math.min(offset+limit, user_count). For user_count=100, limit=50, offset=50 this moves to offset=100 which is past the last record and fetches an empty page. The max valid offset is the start of the last page, not user_count.

findings.title: add_members does not strip whitespace so comma-space lists fail
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb add_members does usernames.split(",").each with no strip. A normal input like "alice, bob" yields " bob" with a leading space, User.find_by_username fails, and the user is silently skipped. The old usernames= path handled this. Strip each token and skip blanks.

findings.title: remove_member bypasses Group#remove logic via users.delete
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb remove_member calls group.users.delete(user_id) directly. Elsewhere membership changes use group.add(user)/group.remove(user), which encapsulate join-model callbacks, counters and side-effects. Deleting the association directly bypasses those and then calls group.save on an already-mutated collection, risking inconsistent group state.

findings.title: members limit/offset unvalidated allows huge or negative paging
findings.body: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb members does limit=(params[:limit]||50).to_i and offset=params[:offset].to_i with no clamping. A caller can request limit=1000000 causing a huge ORDER BY/LIMIT query (DoS/perf), or negative limit/offset which ActiveRecord may interpret unexpectedly. Clamp limit to a sane max and force offset/limit >=0.

findings.title: findMembers returns undefined instead of promise on empty name
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js findMembers changed from returning Ember.RSVP.resolve([]) to bare return when name is empty. Callers expecting a thenable (previous afterModel hooks and any .then chaining) will throw on undefined.then. Return a resolved promise instead.

findings.title: remove_member spec uses wrong HTTP verb so route is untested
findings.body: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb the automatic-group remove_member test calls xhr :put, :remove_member, but config/routes.rb only defines delete members => groups#remove_member. Controller specs dispatch by action name so the test passes while never exercising the real route; a PUT in production would 404. Change the spec to xhr :delete.
